paragraphs: Pérennia is described on its site as an integrated management solution for cemeteries, crematoriums, and funeral homes, designed in Canada. The site says the software centralizes information and management tools so professionals save time and streamline funeral planning. It is accessible on computers, tablets, and mobile devices.

Cemetery and plot management covers work orders, mapping, diagrams, document management, and care and maintenance tracking. A GIS geolocation system supports plot tracking and map-based visualization of operations. Funeral home tools cover funeral planning and mortuary services, from family support to service tracking. Deceased transportation is managed from the first call to the final disposition, with automated tracking for each service.

Billing includes invoices, contracts, and credit notes, with integration to accounting software such as SAGE and to custom APIs. Pre-need planning organizes funeral contracts so families can plan ahead.

quote.text: Proudly designed in Canada, Pérennia is an integrated management solution designed for cemeteries, crematoriums, and funeral homes.
